headline: Researchers find Chinese AI agent fleet scraping rival's map data
summary: Independent researchers identified a swarm of AI agents running on Tencent's infrastructure that targeted Alibaba's Amap mapping service. One report said the agents used urlquery.net to pull entrance data from Amap, logging 1,810 scans in a single day.

claims.statement: Researchers found an AI agent fleet running on Tencent's infrastructure that targeted Alibaba's Amap mapping service.

sources.quote: an agent swarm that seems to be running on Tencent's infrastructure and targeting Alibaba's map service, Amap
AI agents on Tencent Cloud used urlquery.net to pull entrance data from Alibaba’s Amap

claims.statement: The scraping activity included 1,810 scans of Amap in a single day.
